oncall-bot: INCIDENT P1: runtime.serving - elevated error rate and OOMs on us-east-1 GPU pool (alerts: cuda_oom, container_crash) - paging oncall Aisha Patel
oncall-bot: Pager duty: @Aisha Patel is oncall (primary) - acknowledge or escalate in 5m

Marco Ruiz: Seeing a flood of `cuda out of memory` from runtime-pod-**. logs show batcher queue growth quickly before crash

Emma SRE: batcher queue_size spiked to 4096 on model-x-quant at 12:07:23 UTC, lat p99 jumped to 18s then containers OOM at 12:07:45

```
E cuda_runtime: out of memory
  at /usr/local/lib/libcudart.so.11 +0x40a12
  at runtime::kernel_launch
  at batcher::dispatch_async (batcher.cc:412)
  at kv_cache::flush (kv_cache.cc:158)
  at runtime::worker_loop (worker.cc:230)
  at main
```
Aisha Patel: also seeing repeated `deadlock: no progress in batcher` logs right before OOM
Noor (Infra): node-level metrics show memory on GPU nodes trending up and not reclaimed after crash, possible driver zombie

deploy-bot: deploy patch applied by Emma SRE to deployment/model-x (revision: 87 -> 88)

Leo (Customer Success): sending interim customer note: "We're mitigating a runtime issue causing increased latency and failed requests for apps using model-x in us-east. We've routed traffic to a fallback region and are working on a full fix. We'll follow up with timeline and impacted tenants." Want approval to post?
